name: Legion Carbine
description: The Iron Legion service carbine: heavy, reliable and loud, firing solid slugs.
role: The weapon of Zenith garrisons; seeing it means the Legion holds the ground.

artBrief.silhouette: Long rifle with a box magazine.
artBrief.detail: Gunmetal body with a red stripe on the stock and a stamped chevron.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Gunmetal and graphite with Zenith red.
artBrief.spriteScale: Held by a 2×2 cell character; drawn over its skin.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
